info.title: Microsoft Power Platform REST API - monitoringhub
info.description: Unified API for all administrative capabilities in Microsoft Power Platform.

get.description: Triggers when a daily Power Platform Monitor alert rule fires in your tenant and its notification type is Connector or Email and connector. This preview supports daily alert rules and returns alert IDs, metadata, affected resources, and a link to the alert in Power Platform admin center. Each alert is one item in the value array. When using this trigger in a flow, turn on Split On for value to run once per alert.

200.description: Successful request. The response contains one or more alert events.

Location.description: The absolute URL for the next poll, including the API version and updated trigger state.

Retry-After.description: Recommended delay in seconds before the next poll.

202.description: Accepted. No alert events are returned; there is no body and no flow run.

Location.description: The absolute URL for the next poll, including the API version and updated trigger state.

Retry-After.description: Recommended delay in seconds before the next poll.

400.description: Bad request. One or more request parameters are invalid.

401.description: Unauthorized. A valid access token is required.

403.description: Forbidden. You don't have permission to read alerts in this tenant.

429.description: Too many requests. Retry after the indicated delay.

get.x-ms-trigger-hint: In Power Platform admin center, set a daily alert rule's notification type to Connector, then wait for the rule to fire.

post.description: Returns one OTLP JSON ExportMetricsServiceRequest page for 1 to 10 resources of one resource type and subtype in an environment. Each page contains at most 2,000 data points and 4 MiB of uncompressed JSON. To get the next page, repeat the same method, route, API version, and body with the x-ms-continuation response value in the x-ms-continuation request header. The last page has no continuation header. Only elapsed UTC days are eligible. The effective end date is capped at today's UTC midnight; a range with no eligible days returns an empty resourceMetrics array. Missing source data is omitted, not synthesized. Requires a user token with the PowerApps.Apps.Read delegated permission, a Global, Power Platform, Dynamics 365, AI, or Teams administrator role, and tenant preview admission. Application-only tokens and environment RBAC assignments alone don't grant access.

parameters.name: environmentId
parameters.description: The ID of the environment containing the resources. Use 1 to 100 ASCII letters, digits, or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

parameters.name: resourceType
parameters.description: The resource type, matched without regard to case. Supported pairs are PowerApp with CanvasApp, CodeApp, or ModelApp (also accepted as ModelDrivenApp); PowerAutomate with CloudFlow or DesktopFlow; CopilotStudio with Agent; and MicrosoftApp with App.

parameters.name: resourceSubType
parameters.description: The resource subtype for the selected resource type, matched without regard to case. MicrosoftApp requires App and uses the Managed App export action.

parameters.name: x-ms-continuation
parameters.description: The opaque continuation token from the previous page. Omit it for the first page and keep the original route, API version, and request body unchanged.

parameters.name: x-ms-client-request-id
parameters.description: A caller-generated correlation GUID, echoed when valid.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The resource IDs, optional metric selection, and required UTC date range.

200.description: One OTLP JSON page, including an empty resourceMetrics array when no eligible data matches.

x-ms-continuation.description: An opaque token for the next page, present only when more data remains.

x-ms-available-through.description: The exclusive UTC calendar cutoff for eligible days, fixed for the page chain. This isn't a guarantee that source ingestion is complete.

x-ms-record-count.description: The number of OTLP data points in this page.

x-ms-request-id.description: The request correlation ID for support and troubleshooting.

x-ms-client-request-id.description: The caller correlation GUID, when supplied and valid.

400.description: BadRequest indicates an unsupported route pair or metric, invalid resource ID, invalid date range, or invalid or expired continuation token. InvalidRequestContent indicates an invalid JSON body, missing required property, or unknown property.

401.description: A valid authenticated user token is required.

403.description: Required authorization is missing, or the routing tenant doesn't match the authenticated tenant.

404.description: ApiResourceNotFound indicates that the authenticated tenant isn't admitted to the preview.

413.description: RequestEntityTooLarge indicates that one metric record exceeds the 4 MiB response limit.

429.description: The gateway throttled the request. Retry after the indicated delay, if supplied.

Retry-After.description: The delay in seconds before retrying, when supplied by the gateway.

500.description: InternalServerError indicates that the export couldn't produce a valid page.

503.description: ServiceUnavailable indicates a temporary dependency failure or timeout.

MonitoringHubTriggeredAlertsPollResponse.description: A batch of Power Platform Monitor alerts. Use the value array as the Split On target to start a separate flow run for each alert.

value.description: The alerts returned by this poll.

totalCount.description: The number of alerts in this response.

MonitoringHubTriggeredAlert.description: A Power Platform Monitor alert with its rule, metric, and affected-resource details. Unknown indicates an unrecognized value. Optional details are omitted when unavailable.

alertId.description: The ID of the alert instance.

alertRuleId.description: The ID of the alert rule in Power Platform admin center.

monitorCondition.description: Whether the alert has fired or resolved. Daily alert rules currently report Fired only. Unknown indicates an unrecognized condition.

severity.description: The alert severity, or Unknown when the severity isn't recognized.

firedDateTime.description: The time the alert fired, in UTC ISO-8601 format.

resolvedDateTime.description: The time the alert resolved, in UTC ISO-8601 format. Omitted when no resolution time is available.

productType.description: The Power Platform product associated with the alert, or Unknown when unrecognized.

subProductType.description: The type of app, flow, or other resource associated with the alert, or Unknown when unrecognized.

scope.description: Whether the rule monitors a tenant, environment, or resource, or Unknown when unrecognized.

metric.description: The metric monitored by the alert rule, or Unknown when the metric isn't recognized.

metricUnit.description: The unit for the threshold and observed metric values. Percent uses percentage points (95 means 95 percent), Seconds uses seconds, and Count uses item or event counts. Unknown indicates an unrecognized unit.

operator.description: How the metric is compared with the threshold. IsUnder and IsOver exclude equality; IsUnderOrEqual and IsOverOrEqual include equality. Unknown indicates an unrecognized comparison.

threshold.description: The threshold configured for the rule, expressed in Metric Unit. For example, 95 with Percent means 95 percent.

dataReviewPeriod.description: The time period evaluated by the rule, as an ISO-8601 duration, such as PT1H for one hour or P1D for one day.

affectedResourceCount.description: The total number of affected resources, including any resources omitted from the Affected Resources list.

affectedResources.description: A list of affected resource and environment IDs, with observed metric values when available. The list can be limited. Check Affected Resource Count and Affected Resources Truncated to determine whether more resources were affected.

affectedResourcesTruncated.description: True when the Affected Resources list omits one or more resources included in Affected Resource Count.

alertLink.description: A link to view the alert in Power Platform admin center. Sign in with an account that has access to the alert.

tenantId.description: The ID of your Power Platform tenant.

MonitoringHubAffectedResource.description: The IDs of an affected resource and its environment, with the observed metric value when available.

environmentId.description: The environment ID: a GUID, or Default-{tenant GUID} for the default environment.

resourceId.description: The ID of the affected resource.

metricValue.description: The observed value for this resource, expressed in the alert's Metric Unit. Omitted when unavailable.

MonitoringHubMetricsExportRequest.description: The export selection. Unknown properties, including scope, lookbackDays, and maxRecords, are rejected.

resourceIds.description: The IDs of 1 to 10 resources of the route's resource type and subtype in the environment. Each ID must be a non-empty, non-zero GUID in hyphenated format. Duplicate GUIDs are rejected, including case variants.

metricNames.description: Up to 20 distinct supported metric names for the selected route pair. Omit this property or supply null to export all mapped metrics for that pair. An empty array or unsupported name is rejected. Names are trimmed and matched without regard to case; duplicates are consolidated and output names are canonical.

MonitoringHubMetricsExportTimeRange.description: A UTC date range of at most 30 days, with an inclusive start and exclusive end.

startDate.description: The first UTC day to export, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: The UTC day after the last requested day, in YYYY-MM-DD format. It must be later than startDate. The effective end is capped at today's UTC midnight.

MonitoringHubMetricsExportPage.description: An OTLP JSON ExportMetricsServiceRequest with no proprietary wrapper.

resourceMetrics.description: The metrics grouped by Power Platform resource, or an empty array.

MonitoringHubOtlpResourceMetrics.description: The metrics for one Power Platform resource.

scopeMetrics.description: The metrics grouped by instrumentation scope.

MonitoringHubOtlpResource.description: Resource attributes identifying the service, tenant, environment, resource type, subtype, and resource ID. Resource display names aren't emitted.

MonitoringHubOtlpScopeMetrics.description: The metrics from one instrumentation scope.

MonitoringHubOtlpInstrumentationScope.description: The instrumentation scope producing the metrics.

MonitoringHubOtlpMetric.description: A metric and its daily values. Counts use delta monotonic sums. Ratios and timings use gauges. Non-Managed App timings are P75; Managed App timings are daily averages. Only gauge or sum is emitted for a metric.

unit.description: The unit, using 1 for ratios, {count} for counts, and s for seconds.

MonitoringHubOtlpGauge.description: The data points of a gauge metric.

MonitoringHubOtlpSum.description: The data points of a delta monotonic sum metric.

aggregationTemporality.description: The aggregation temporality. The service emits 1 for delta.

MonitoringHubOtlpNumberDataPoint.description: A daily metric value, with either asInt or asDouble.

attributes.description: The public data-point dimensions, when present.

timeUnixNano.description: The value's time in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch, encoded as a decimal string.

asInt.description: The integer count, encoded as a decimal string, when present.

MonitoringHubOtlpKeyValue.description: An attribute key and string value.

MonitoringHubErrorResponse.description: The error response returned when an export fails.

code.description: A stable error code, such as BadRequest, InvalidRequestContent, or ServiceUnavailable.
